title: Nonconstant nonzero low degree monomials
statement: Let $r,\ell$ be nonnegative integers, and assign an $\mathbb{F}_2$ coefficient to each subset of $\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$ of size at most $\ell$. The selected monomials are exactly those indexed by a nonempty subset whose coefficient is nonzero.
hypotheses_covered: coefficient function is defined on subsets of $\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$ of size at most $\ell$
